Chapter 1456 - 6: Ascending The Heavenly Steps

Chapter 1456 - 6: Ascending the Heavenly Steps

"White jade steps?"

Lin Yuan carefully observed the step after step of seemingly endless white jade steps.

Compared to the white jade steps he had seen twice before-in dreams and in visions from fragments of the future-

This time, with the white jade steps appearing directly before him, they were much clearer, with the surface etched with incredibly mysterious patterns, as if they could explain the ultimate essence of endless dimensions.

"Currently, there shouldn't be many legendary lords starting to climb these white jade steps."

Lin Yuan glanced around; although the transcendent power forming the white jade steps penetrated the entire dimensional plane, many legendary lords hadn't rushed over immediately.

Like Lin Yuan, who was a step later.

And there were lords even later than Lin Yuan.

Furthermore,

there were as many as thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three white jade steps.

This largely dispersed the many legendary lords.

"Is it my future from millions of years later to climb this path of transcendence?"

Lin Yuan felt slightly curious in his heart; within Wanwei space-time, in the vision of summoning his future self, he saw a figure

continuously ascending the steps.

"Let's begin."

After briefly pondering for a moment, Lin Yuan stepped onto the white jade steps.

When Lin Yuan's right foot landed on the white jade steps, he first felt his Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao trembling.

"This?"

The artistic conception of Lin Yuan's Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao began to rise, vaguely transforming toward the supreme direction.

"The Supreme Rule Dao, it's the Supreme Rule Dao, my Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao is evolving toward the Supreme Rule Dao."

Even though he had long known from the Violet Light Legendary Lord about the benefits of climbing the white jade steps, Lin Yuan couldn't help but feel excited at this moment.

Whether it's a Time Being, a Time Lord, or even a Legendary Lord, what they've comprehended are merely Chaotic Origin Dao.

As for the Supreme Rule Dao? That is fundamental to maintaining the endless dimensional planes; if the Supreme Rule Dao has a concrete will, it would be the Fourteenth Rank Perfect Time Being overlooking the endless dimensional planes.

Unfortunately, the Supreme Rule Dao does not possess a will; its so-called will is more like an instinct, without any thought.

Similar to a piece of 'intelligence' in a technology-type dimensional space.

"Just seeing the direction, it's still far from fully transforming into the Supreme Rule Dao."

Lin Yuan's thoughts gathered.

Of course, even merely seeing the direction is extremely important.

Below the Time Lord, the path of cultivation, though difficult, still generally has guidance.

However, after comprehending the Chaotic Origin Dao, the guidance

is lost, and why do the Third Realm lords explore various paths of transcendence at this stage?

It's because the way forward has been locked, and only through transcendence can everything be broken open.

In essence, the cultivation of the Third Realm lords is equivalent to groping forward in endless darkness.

Any slight carelessness results in falling and death.

Before the appearance of the endless white jade steps, far too many lords fell on various paths of transcendence.

Especially on the three main paths of transcendence, over long years, many lords were buried, among them those incredibly talented, on the verge of reaching the end of a transcendental path.

"Pressure and distortion force?"

Not long after stepping onto the first white jade step, Lin Yuan, aside from feeling the tremor of his Chaotic Origin Dao, noticed a faint

pressure and distortion force enveloping him.

This pressure and distortion force targeted not only the physical body

and soul but also the mind and will.

However, with Lin Yuan's current strength, blocking this pressure and distortion force was quite simple.

"Can't be careless."

Lin Yuan's expression turned slightly serious.

The pressure and distortion force were not strong now, but as he continued to climb the endless white jade steps, this force would continuously increase.

This is what the Violet Light Legendary Lord learned from the information garnered by the legendary lords who were the first to climb the endless white jade steps.

"Continue."

Lin Yuan paused on the first white jade step for roughly a few breaths

before stepping onto the second white jade step.

To step onto the next step, besides needing to resist the pressure and distortion force, one must comprehend their Chaotic Origin Dao to

the extreme of the current step.

The purpose of the white jade steps is akin to establishing a road from one's Chaotic Origin Dao to the Supreme Rule Dao; however, to walk this path, one must rely on themselves.

As time passed, during the ascent of the endless white jade steps, Lin Yuan occasionally saw other legendary lords.

These legendary lords, compared to Lin Yuan, often paused for a few days to several tens of days on a particular step before moving to the

next.

Thus, even the first batch that stepped onto the endless white jade steps were surpassed by Lin Yuan within just a few short days.

On the endless white jade steps.

Lin Yuan ascended neither hurriedly nor slowly, but within, he contemplated continuously.

"Climbing these white jade steps is indeed slowly transforming the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao."

In the depths of Lin Yuan's eyes faintly appeared a great Dao interwoven in black and white, "Any Chaotic Origin Dao extends from the Supreme Rule Dao; the Dao produces one, one produces two, two produces three, and three produces all things. The Supreme Rule Dao is that Dao, and even beyond the Dao, it is 'zero,' the 'source." The climbing of the white jade steps not only allowed Lin Yuan's Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao to transform but also significantly advanced his understanding of the essence of the Dao. "Why did these white jade steps appear? Transcendent power? Transcendent power also has a source. Which transcendent being did this? But why would that transcendent being do such a thing?"
